title: Invertibility of the ordinary exact-mate projective-line exchange
statement: For every finite commutative ring A, every morphism g:Sprime->S, and every ordinary unbounded coefficient complex M on P1_S, the specified exact-mate exchange ordinaryFiniteP1Exchange A g M of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows] is invertible.

proof.text: Projective space is proper. A finite ring is additively torsion, so unbounded torsion-ring proper base change gives invertibility of the derived mate.

Transport the mate along the canonical isomorphisms between left-derived inverse image and the exact termwise inverse image. Whiskering by isomorphisms and conjugation of adjunctions preserve invertibility. Expanding the canonical square isomorphisms gives the exact mate used by ordinaryFiniteP1Exchange.
